title: Service Restored – Welcome Back!
mainText:
Dear Valued User,

We are pleased to inform you that our application is now back online! The temporary outage has been resolved, and you can once again enjoy our services, including the exciting new "Experience Level" feature.

We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding during this time. Our team has worked tirelessly to ensure everything is running smoothly, and we are confident you will love the improvements.

Thank you for your continued support. Should you encounter any issues or have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to our support team.

Welcome back!

Best regards,
Rapid Recap
